title: helianthemum stoechadifolium
intro: Helianthemum stoechadifolium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and stress due to its adaptogenic and calming effects. The health benefits of Rockrose are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which may exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. These constituents may also contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedation, pain relief, and protection against oxidative stress.
